Hello there <:Saya_yum:1513124263291387975> 

- team 1 & 2 : seem fine to me for a starter.
- team 3 : did you prevent  Lotan:C from activating the alternate chaos realm on purpose ?
- team 4 : poison tends to be rather slow. I would sub Jenkins with Faros ( and Winkle with Celeste ) to maximize your output.
- team 5 : you got Aurita and Corpo. Get your hands on Saya and you'll have a decent discard team, even with Corposant's recent nerf.
Or you could go aequor/ultra with Cassiah.

These teams can get you through the first stage of D-tide. To go further you'll need to tweak them and work and cov and posse but you'll get there as you play <:Saya_caught:1513123193341349968>

content:
It can always be optimized <:Saya_caught:1513123193341349968> 

But your first and third linups seem the most balanced to me.
That said, you will eventually want 19 awakeners for 5 functionnal teams ( D-tide ) so I can only encourrage you to mess around with anyone on you roster and get used to them <:Saya_duel:1513123467917135903>
I've been told that my third team would be better like that : mouchette / aigis / thaïs / helot

Don't know about better but it would work, yes. You're swapping a keyflare giver for another.

Thaïs, Horla, Saya, Clementine, Tawil, Caraboo, ...
There are a number of supports that fit great in any team.
Thaïs gives lots of aliemus and debuffs the enemy. Cara brings huge boons but you don't chose them ( only when they will apply ). Ramona gives you arithmetica discount and draw. Horla comes with passive boost once you leap. Clementine guves strength, keyflare, heal and debuffs.
These are only a few exemples.

In my opinion it's mostly a matter of preference and your own playstyle. You could get the very best team ( if that even exists ) but still fail to progress because you don't know how to use them / don't enjoy their gameplay

And if you're planning long term, two thing to keep in mind 
- 5 teams means you will probably need to spread your strongest units even when they have a great synergy
- you will yet get more awakeners so even your ace team for event will change over time.

I'd say, just don't worry too much and enjoy arc 1, it's a great place to try out all manner of different matchups <:Saya_duel:1513123467917135903>
But yeah, in the end this is only my own opinion. If someone else's suggestion feels right to you, then it simply is right for you
